title: Several Bluetooth errors are not understandable for end-user, or displayed
line: When a Bluetooth device fails to connect, System Settings and the Bluetooth notification now say why in plain words instead of showing codes like "br-connection-create-socket".
explanation: When Device1.Connect fails, BlueZ returns org.bluez.Error.Failed with a short reason code such as br-connection-create-socket or br-connection-page-timeout. The Bluetooth KCM put that code straight into its error banner (main page, device page and the Bigscreen sidebar), and the applet's notification only knew "Host is down" and otherwise said "Connection to the device failed". The change adds a mapping of every br-/le-connection reason from BlueZ's src/error.h to a short translated sentence in the bluetooth QML plugin's Utils singleton, used by the KCM banners and the applet notification; unknown reasons still show BlueZ's text in the KCM and the generic text in the notification.

commits.message:
kcm, applet: show readable text for Bluetooth connection errors

When connecting failed, the KCM showed BlueZ's raw failure reason, like
"br-connection-create-socket", and the applet's notification only said
that the connection failed. Both now map BlueZ's reasons to plain text.

BUG: 467122

media.caption: System Settings > Bluetooth, Connect fails: banner shows the raw code "br-connection-create-socket"
Same failure: banner says the connection could not be set up and to check the device is on and in range
Applet, Connect fails: notification only says "Connection to the device failed"
Same failure: notification gives the same readable reason as the KCM

review.text: Moving the BlueZ error-code mapping to C++ in Utils so the KCM pages and applet notification share plain-language translated messages is the right direction and avoids duplicating tables in QML. However, despite claiming to map every br-/le-connection reason from BlueZ's src/error.h, the mapping omits "br-connection-profile-unavailable" (one of the most common BlueZ connection errors users encounter). Additionally, Q_INVOKABLE Utils::errorText(BluezQt::PendingCall *) dereferences call without a null check and ignores call->error(), leaving KCM and applet handling inconsistent (e.g. NotReady is only translated in the applet, and other PendingCall::Error codes still leave the applet notification text empty).
changes: Add a readable translated message for "br-connection-profile-unavailable" in Utils::connectionErrorText().
Guard against a null BluezQt::PendingCall * in Q_INVOKABLE Utils::errorText().

Handle PendingCall::Error codes (such as NotReady and a sensible fallback for other errors) consistently across Utils::errorText() and DevicesStateProxyModel::errorText() so KCM banners don't show raw text for known enum errors and applet notifications don't fall through to an empty body.
